basic_details.scholarship_name: University of Alberta Computing Science Graduate Award & Amii AI Fellowship
basic_details.offering_entity: University of Alberta (Department of Computing Science, Faculty of Science) & Alberta Machine Intelligence Institute (Amii)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: University of Alberta Main Campus (North Campus, Edmonton, Alberta, Canada)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Restricted to thesis-based graduate degrees in Computing Science: Artificial Intelligence, Reinforcement Learning, Machine Learning, Computer Vision, Multimedia Systems, Robotics, Software Systems, and Algorithmics.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: 100% of admitted thesis graduate students receive guaranteed full financial support (~80 to 120 funded graduate students admitted annually)
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open international competition; Pakistani graduates in CS and software engineering represent a strong cohort (typically 8 to 15 awardees/yr)
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Up to 2 years for MSc Thesis; up to 4 years for PhD, with guaranteed minimum departmental funding package

nationality_requirements: Open to international and domestic applicants holding a valid passport
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Completed 4-year Bachelor's degree (16 years education) for MSc; completed Master's degree (18 years education) for PhD from an HEC-recognized university with minimum 3.40 / 4.00 CGPA (78%+ aggregate; 3.60+ competitive from NUST, FAST-NUCES, GIKI, UET, LUMS, PIEAS).
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum UAlberta equivalent GPA of 3.30 on 4.0 scale over last 60 credits (2 years full-time study).
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: BSc or MSc in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, or Statistics with solid coursework in data structures, algorithms, calculus, and linear algebra.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduating final-year students eligible; must complete degree and confer official transcript before September intake.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Not mandatory. Strong open-source code repositories (GitHub), Kaggle achievements, or research publications (NeurIPS, ICML, CVPR, IROS) significantly enhance competitiveness.

english_proficiency.notes: IELTS Academic overall min 7.0 (each section 6.0+), TOEFL iBT min 100 (sub-scores 21+), or Duolingo min 125. MOI certificates not accepted.

eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: None; English is the official language of instruction, research, and campus life.
eligibility_requirements.gender_specific_requirements: None; female candidates in computing and machine learning strongly encouraged.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Thesis-based researchers in reinforcement learning, AI systems, and computational intelligence.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Cannot hold multiple full external fellowships exceeding university maximum award policy.

tuition_fee.details: Tuition costs offset via departmental tuition support and Graduate Research Assistantship Fellowships (~CAD 9,500 to CAD 11,000 / year).

admission_application_fee.details: University of Alberta international graduate application fee (CAD 135) paid online.

accommodation.details: Paid out of guaranteed living stipend; on-campus graduate residences (Michener Park, Graduate Residence) or private Edmonton rentals average CAD 700 to 1,000/month.

monthly_stipend.details: Guaranteed minimum annual funding package: CAD 24,000 to CAD 29,000 / year (~CAD 2,000 to 2,416 / month; ~PKR 400,000 to 485,000/month) provided via Teaching Assistantships (TA), Graduate Research Assistantships (GRA), and Amii fellowships.

airfare.details: Travel between Pakistan and Edmonton International Airport (YEG) is self-funded by student.

visa_fee.details: Canadian Study Permit application fee (CAD 150) and biometrics fee (CAD 85) paid to Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada (IRCC).

health_insurance.details: Alberta Health Care Insurance Plan (AHCIP) provides 100% free basic provincial hospital/physician coverage for international students holding study permits, supplemented by UAlberta GSA Health & Dental Plan.
health_insurance.amount: Free provincial health care + GSA health plan covered

food_allowance.details: Living expenses covered by monthly assistantship; Edmonton offers among the lowest living costs among major Canadian research hubs.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: High-performance GPU computing clusters, Amii supercomputing access, and lab workstations provided by department.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: GSA and Amii travel grants provide CAD 1,500 to 3,000 per paper for presenting at flagship conferences (NeurIPS, ICML, CVPR, AAAI).

travel_transit_allowance.details: Edmonton Transit Service (ETS) U-Pass included in student registration fees, granting unlimited bus and LRT transit.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single leading Canadian research university: University of Alberta (Edmonton, Canada)
participating_institutions: University of Alberta - Department of Computing Science (North Campus, Edmonton)
Alberta Machine Intelligence Institute (Amii - Pan-Canadian AI Strategy Institute)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: Top 100 global university (QS World #96); top 5 globally in Artificial Intelligence and Reinforcement Learning (home of Sutton & Barto RL pioneers and DeepMind AlphaGo founders).
available_majors: MSc / PhD in Computing Science: Reinforcement Learning & Autonomous Agents
MSc / PhD in Computing Science: Computer Vision & Multimedia
MSc / PhD in Computing Science: Natural Language Processing & Machine Learning
MSc / PhD in Computing Science: Robotics & Autonomous Systems
MSc / PhD in Computing Science: Software Systems, Databases, & Cloud Computing
university_and_program_options.program_duration: MSc Thesis: 2 years (4 to 5 semesters); PhD: 4 to 5 years full-time.
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Bachelor's or Master's in CS/STEM with 3.4+ GPA, 3 academic recommendation letters, CV, statement of purpose, supervisor pre-match strongly recommended, and IELTS 7.0 / TOEFL 100.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Reinforcement Learning, Deep Learning, and Computer Vision under Amii faculty are intensely competitive; Software Systems, Theory, and Multimedia offer slightly higher acceptance rates.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Prospective applicants to thesis programs should review the faculty directory, identify 2-3 professors matching their research thesis, and contact them between September and November. An endorsement from a faculty member guarantees admission and full funding.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: University of Alberta Graduate Application Portal (GSMS)
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Create an account on the UAlberta Graduate Studies Portal, select Department of Computing Science, specify degree route (MSc Thesis or PhD), list prospective supervisors, and upload required documents.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1 (September - November): Review Computing Science faculty research areas; contact prospective supervisors with CV, transcripts, and research statement.
Step 2 (October - Mid-December): Register on UAlberta Graduate Application Portal (ualberta.ca/graduate-studies); complete profile.
Step 3 (November - December): Upload unofficial transcripts, CV, statement of purpose, and enter contact information for 3 academic referees.
Step 4 (By 15 December): Pay application fee (CAD 135) and submit application before Fall admission deadline.
Step 5 (January - February): Departmental Graduate Admissions Committee reviews applications; faculty members select candidates for lab interviews.
Step 6 (March - April): Official admission offers with guaranteed funding letters released; accepted candidates accept offer in portal.
Step 7 (April - May): Apply for Canadian Study Permit via IRCC online portal; complete biometrics and medical exam in Pakistan.
Step 8 (Late August / Early September): Travel to Edmonton, attend Computing Science graduate orientation, and begin teaching/research assistantship.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated automatic funding: All admitted thesis-based graduate students receive guaranteed departmental funding; no separate scholarship application required.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Three academic recommendation letters submitted electronically via referee email portal generated by GSMS.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Statement of Purpose (1-2 pages): Detail research background, technical projects, publications, specific research topics of interest, and why UAlberta is the ideal fit.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Structured research statement (1-2 pages) describing research interests, methodologies, and proposed supervisors.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Academic CV detailing programming skills, research publications, technical projects, GitHub profile, and academic honors.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Technical video interviews (30-45 minutes via Zoom/Google Meet) conducted by prospective faculty supervisors evaluating coding, mathematical foundations, and research intuition.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS 7.0 or TOEFL 100 or Duolingo 125. GRE is NOT required for admission.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Unofficial scans uploaded for application; official attested transcripts from HEC Pakistan required upon admission offer.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified English translations for any documents not in English.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: 100% digital submission via the UAlberta GSMS online application system.

required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Ensure clear color scan of Pakistani machine-readable passport.

required_documents_checklist.document_name: Official Academic Transcripts and Degree Certificates
required_documents_checklist.specification: Complete transcripts of all university education with grading scale and degree completion certificates.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: HEC Pakistan attestation required on final official documents upon offer acceptance.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Structured 1 to 2 page statement of research background, objectives, and professor alignment.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Specifically name UAlberta faculty members whose lab papers you have studied.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Confidential recommendation letters from former professors or research mentors.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Must be submitted from verified institutional email accounts.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Official IELTS Academic (7.0+), TOEFL iBT (100+), or Duolingo (125+) scorecard.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Electronic score reporting to University of Alberta institutional code.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Academic CV detailing coding skills, publications, capstone projects, and GitHub links.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Highlight contributions to open source or Scopus/IEEE papers.

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Main intake cycle is Fall (September). Winter (January) intake has very limited supervisory funding openings.

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 35% (CGPA in relevant computer science and mathematics coursework, class rank)
selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 35% (Prior thesis quality, publications, open-source repositories, and technical skills)
selection_process_and_weights.work_experience_weight: 5% (Industry software engineering, AI internships, or data engineering roles)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 10% (Clarity of research vision, intellectual curiosity, and fit with department)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Computing Science Graduate Admissions Committee & individual faculty lab heads.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Two-phase holistic review: Graduate admissions committee pre-screens applicants for academic and English compliance; individual faculty supervisors review applicant files and interview candidates to make binding funding and admission offers.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: ~1,500 to 2,200 international applicants across thesis MSc and PhD
competitiveness_profile.total_scholarships_awarded: ~80 to 120 fully funded graduate admission offers
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~9.5% (Strong representation of Pakistani graduates from NUST, FAST, GIKI, UET in computing labs)
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Solid foundation in data structures, algorithms, and math; 1+ published papers or strong software portfolio; clear thesis direction.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: BS/MS graduates in Computer Science and Software Engineering from NUST, FAST-NUCES, GIKI, UET, and LUMS.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: China, India, Pakistan, Iran, Nigeria, Bangladesh, Canada

fake_websites_and_scams: Unauthorized recruiters charging high fees for guaranteed UAlberta CS admission. UAlberta admissions are handled solely through its official portal.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Standard application fee is CAD 135 paid directly in the application portal. Never pay fees to third parties.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Do not hire agents; professors seek independent researchers capable of writing scientific publications.
hidden_costs_breakdown: Canadian Study Permit application and biometrics fees (CAD 235; ~PKR 47,000).
Flight tickets from Pakistan to Edmonton (~PKR 280,000 - 420,000).
Winter clothing and initial apartment security deposit (~CAD 1,500; ~PKR 300,000).
misleading_claims_debunked: CLAIM: Course-based Master's programs receive full funding. (FACT: Guaranteed funding applies strictly to thesis-based MSc and PhD degrees).
CLAIM: GRE is mandatory. (FACT: GRE scores are NOT required by UAlberta Computing Science).
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Commercial blogs state living in Edmonton requires CAD 2,000/mo; official university budgets estimate CAD 1,300 to 1,500/mo for graduate students.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain minimum cumulative GPA of 3.0 / 4.0 in graduate courses and achieve satisfactory progress on thesis milestones.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time physical research residency on campus in Edmonton and fulfillment of teaching assistant duties.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Annual progress reports reviewed by the Supervisory Committee and Departmental Graduate Chair.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Funded students must fulfill TA duties (typically 12 hours/week) during teaching terms; external off-campus work is restricted to avoid delaying thesis research.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None. International graduates are eligible for Canada's Post-Graduation Work Permit (PGWP) of up to 3 years and provincial nomination (AAIP) permanent residency pathways.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: Zero service bonds or return obligations.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Funding ceases if student withdraws or fails academic standing; past received assistantship funds are not clawed back.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Changing thesis topic or supervisor requires formal department approval.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Funding is guaranteed for standard degree duration (2 years MSc, 4 years PhD); subsequent funding extensions depend on supervisor research grants.
